0022600025.text: The Atlanta Hawks (5-4, 1st in the Southeast, 4th in the East) host the Washington Wizards (4-4, 8th in the East) in the Hawks' 10th game of the 2026-27 season. Atlanta has won its last two games and is 4-2 on the road but 1-2 at home, while Washington has lost its last game and sits 0.5 games behind the Southeast's second spot. Atlanta is missing Henri Veesaar (knee), Jalen Johnson (ankle), Jock Landale (hip) and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture), and Asa Newell (toe) is day-to-day and a game-time decision, while Washington is without Jamir Watkins (knee surgery), Justin Champagnie (foot), Reece Beekman (shoulder) and Tristan Vukcevic (hip, pinched nerve). The Hawks lead the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after winning 120-105 in Washington on November 4, and they also won the 2025-26 series 3-1.
